prompt:
The chart below shows the number of new homes completed in five districts of one city in 2015 and in 2022.

Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.
instruction_line: You should spend about 20 minutes on this task. Write at least 150 words.

visual.title: New homes completed in five districts, 2015 and 2022
visual.alt: A bar chart comparing the number of new homes completed in five districts of a city in 2015 and 2022.

key_points: First place changes hands: Highbeck (640 homes) was well ahead in 2015, but Millfield (720 homes) takes the lead in 2022
Millfield rises from 260 to 720, almost tripling — the largest increase
Highbeck falls from 640 to 380, the biggest decline; Northgate also drops, from 420 to 310
Sandcove (180 → 240) and Lowmoor (95 → 150) increase modestly; Lowmoor has the fewest homes completed in both years
The total across the five districts rises from 1,595 to 1,800, a modest increase; the real change is that construction shifts between districts
The gap between districts is sharper in 2022: the difference between the highest and lowest rises from 545 to 570
common_mistakes: Reading the five districts in order without highlighting the biggest increase and the biggest decrease
Missing that the ranking changes hands
Describing the number of homes as if it were a percentage ('40% of homes were in Millfield')
Inventing a reason ('land ran out in Highbeck') — no such information is in the chart
